entries.title: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated November 2
entries.author: Kaivax
entries.excerpt: Since the last full update to the Beta on October 15, we’ve continued to work to solve issues, refine classes, improve gameplay in all areas, and address feedback we received from Beta testers. What follows are the updates and changes that have been developed over those last 2.5 weeks. We’ve included the previously-posted updates to racial talents and abilities for completeness here.
